Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website:www.mcgm.gov.in . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BMC Sonologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the BMC Sonologist recruitment is 25 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authorities before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Sonologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in the concerned subject and have at least 1 year of experience after completing their PG. Registration with the Maharashtra Medical Council is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Sonologist positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Sonologist posts is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the BMC Sonologist jobs?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the BMC Sonologist recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Sonologist posts?
faq.answer: The salary is paid per patient. For General Sonography, it is Rs. 250/- per patient, and for Anomaly Scan/Color Doppler/2D Echo, it is Rs. 500/- per patient.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by Empanelment. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is HO/468/ARNAH dated 12.08.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Sonologist posts released by BMC is contractual.
